svg.title: Yeony — Small ideas. Useful possibilities.
svg.desc: Yeony creative tools. A thick, beveled Möbius belt shown at an angle that reveals its half-twist, with six yellow highlights flowing along one continuous surface. The highlights alternate front and back, cross the half-twist without duplication, and complete their full surface circuit in 16.8 seconds. Six short face-normal markers rotate around all three local axes: negative X, positive Y, and negative Z. The Z rotation follows the original clockwise orbit in the reference front view. Each axis completes a revolution in 30 seconds.

g.aria-label: A thick beveled Möbius belt. Six yellow highlights flow along one continuous surface, alternating front and back without mirrored highlights. The twist stays fixed.
